DUST-DEVIL SPIRAL — towering rust-orange dust-devil spiral clawing up from the hardpan directly across the rig's path, the column shredding loose scrap-metal and brittle bone-dry brush into its vortex, the driver locked on a collision course with the swirling wall

SANDSTORM WALL APPROACHING — continental sandstorm wall consuming the entire upper horizon in boiling sepia-orange, the rig silhouetted black against it in foreground, the crew wrapping faces in rags as the light dies and the wall swallows the sky

VEHICLE-WRECK FIREBALL — a pursuer's war-buggy detonates in a rolling orange fireball twenty meters behind the hero rig, secondary fuel-cell explosions chaining outward, a tire arcing through black smoke-column overhead, the shockwave visibly rippling the dust around the rig's rear wheels

MOLOTOV-EXPLOSION — molotov cocktail mid-bloom at the apex of impact against a pursuer's hood, bright orange-white fireball expanding outward, the thrower's arm still extended in follow-through, burning fuel cascading across the pursuer's cracked windshield as the driver recoils

OIL-DERRICK BURNING DISTANT — collapsed oil-derrick burning in deep distance at the two-o'clock horizon, the smoke-column rising black and fat into the sepia sky, the rig speeding past in sharp foreground silhouette, the distant fire the only warm light in the dead flats

WRECKAGE-SCATTERED FOREGROUND — burned-out car-shells, axle-frames and twisted spinal-column wreckage of prior convoy ambushes litter the foreground hardpan, the rig threading between them at full throttle, a cracked skull mounted on a bonnet-spike passing inches from the hero's door

VULTURES-CIRCLING OVERHEAD — a loose gyre of eight vultures hanging in the bleached upper-frame sky, black against the white heat, banking lazily over the chase route below, one already descending toward a still-smoking wreck the rig just passed

ROAD-DEBRIS-SCATTER — fresh spike-strip and coiled barbed-wire deployed across the road ahead, chunks of engine-block and shattered axle-casing scattered between, the rig hauling hard left in mid-evasive lurch, one rear tire already dragging a coil of wire and sparking

MIRAGE-HEAT-SHIMMER — heat-shimmer rising in thick waves from the cracked hardpan mid-distance, the nearest pursuer dissolving into rippling ghost-image at the shimmer-line, the horizon pooling into false water, the road itself appearing to liquefy and vanish beneath the rig's wheels

DUST-CLOUD-OVERTAKE — the pursuit pack's combined dust-cloud rolling over the hero rig from behind like a breaking wave, pursuit-vehicles emerging through its brown wall in ragged formation, the gunner on the rig's roof rack disappearing briefly into the engulfing murk

FUEL-SPILL TRAIL — ruptured fuel-drum dragging a glistening slick-trail behind the rig across the hardpan, sparks from the shredded rear-fender dropping into it every few seconds, the rear gunner screaming toward the cab, the ignition fuse crawling backward toward the tank

CONVOY-FLARE OVERHEAD — enemy signal-flare arcing high across the upper frame, its smoke-trail curving a dirty red signature across the bleached sky, calling reinforcements somewhere beyond the dunes, the rig's crew clocking it with grim recognition and pushing the throttle harder

SUPPRESSION-FIRE TRACER — incoming tracer-rounds from a pursuing war-rig's roof-mounted MG raking orange-white arcs across the air around the hero rig, near-miss sparks spitting off welded armor plating, the driver snapping the wheel hard as rounds walk across the dust ahead

CHAIN-WHIP CRACK — heavy logging-chain mid-swing from a pursuer's chain-pole weapon catching the enemy bike's front fork in frozen impact, the rider's body pitching forward over the bars, the chain-wielder leaning into the follow-through, debris and teeth scattering into the dust

DUNE-CREST LAUNCH — the rig cresting a steep dune-ridge at full speed, all four wheels clearing the lip in mid-arc silhouette, dust trail hanging suspended at the take-off point, the desert flat below spreading wide to receive the landing, suspension already compressing for impact

ROAD-WARRIOR HORDE INCOMING — twelve pursuit-vehicles visible at the deep horizon in loose ragged formation, dust-trails braiding together into a single dirty contrail behind them, the mass of engines audible as a bass-drone, the scale of the oncoming horde dwarfing the emptiness around the rig

THUNDERSTORM ROLLING — dry-lightning thunderstorm front rolling in low across the wasteland behind the pursuit, an intermittent flash briefly bleaching the entire scene white, the rig caught in the strobing light mid-turn, the storm-front edge extending the full width of the horizon in blue-black

WATER-OASIS REVELATION — sudden glimpse of actual green and standing water visible through a gap in the rock-cut ahead, the crew's heads turning in disbelief mid-chase, one fighter pressing their face to the broken window glass, the rig not slowing, the oasis sliding past

ENGINE-FIRE COMPLICATION — hood-fire boiling black smoke from the rig's engine-bay mid-drive, a crew member leaning out the cab door with a rag-wrapped arm swinging at the flames, another spraying the last of a fire-extinguisher through the grille slats, the drive not stopping

RAM-PRONG IMPACT-MOMENT — the rig's welded ram-prong punching into a pursuer's driver-side door in frozen contact, the enemy vehicle's frame buckling inward, the driver and a loose gunner both airborne in the impact flash, the hero rig's prow visibly crumpling and pushing through
